title: M2.5 preload / threads / OD33 flange contact-separation
fastener_candidate: 3× ISO 4762 M2.5×0.45, A4-70 class; exact finish/lubrication/supplier under T06

local_screens.note: strip model uses only one head-diameter effective width and is intentionally conservative; final local FEA is verification authority

torque_process.rule: Do not release torque from T=KFd alone. Calibrate exact screw finish/lubricant against 200–300 N preload using torque-clamp testing analogous to ISO 16047; record lot/process.
torque_process.expected_engineering_range_only_Nm: ~0.06–0.15 for K≈0.12–0.20; NOT a drawing torque.

decision: OD33/3×M2.5 is not rejected by preload/thread/contact screening. Keep geometry frozen and run one local structural/contact verification after seal/process freeze.
